schema_note.source_relation: DIRECT = the evaluation dataset is named in the pretraining description; SAME_COLLECTION = a parent corpus is named and the evaluation dataset is one of its sub-corpora; NONE_FOUND = not found in the materials checked (not a proof of absence)
schema_note.exposure_status: EXPOSED = no exclusion reported; EXCLUDED_RECORDING / EXCLUDED_SUBJECT = authors report removing the evaluation recordings or subjects from pretraining; CONTROL_RUN = authors re-pretrained without the dataset and report both numbers; UNKNOWN
schema_note.evidence: paper location and verbatim quote; the registry file holds the page index convention
schema_note.author_confirmation: scope and date of a confirmation by the model authors; absent means not asked or not answered, never a denial

evidence.quote: Given that the TUEV dataset is a subset of the pretraining dataset TUEG, we introduced an additional experimental setup, CBraMod (excluding TUEV), to eliminate potential effects of data leakage.
